```{r}
#| label: setup

library(brms)
library(posterior)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "09-imaging", "results")
adjusted_model_path <- file.path(results_dir, "model-adjusted.rds")
unadjusted_model_path <- file.path(results_dir, "model-unadjusted.rds")

imaging_data <- read_parquet(file.path(results_dir, "analysis-data.parquet"))
completed_datasets <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "completed-datasets.rds"))
```

## Prior

```{r}
#| label: prior

coefficient_prior <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 2.5), class = "b"),
  # Exponential tail: the brms default shape prior lets a chain drift to the
  # Poisson limit (shape -> infinity). Same shape prior as the blood products.
  prior(gamma(0.01, 0.01), class = "shape")
)
```

## Convergence rule

```{r}
#| label: convergence-rule

thresholds <- config$diagnostics

fit_diagnostics <- function(fit) {
  draw_summary <- summarise_draws(fit, "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")
  nuts <- nuts_params(fit)
  max_treedepth <- control_params(fit)$max_treedepth

  tibble(
    iterations = fit$fit@sim$iter,
    max_rhat = max(draw_summary$rhat),
    min_ess_bulk = min(draw_summary$ess_bulk),
    min_ess_tail = min(draw_summary$ess_tail),
    divergences = sum(nuts$Value[nuts$Parameter == "divergent__"]),
    treedepth_hits = sum(
      nuts$Value[nuts$Parameter == "treedepth__"] >= max_treedepth
    ),
    min_bfmi = min(rstan::get_bfmi(fit$fit))
  )
}

passes_thresholds <- function(diagnostics) {
  with(diagnostics, coalesce(
    max_rhat <= thresholds$max_rhat &
      min_ess_bulk >= thresholds$min_ess_bulk &
      min_ess_tail >= thresholds$min_ess_tail &
      divergences <= thresholds$max_divergent_transitions &
      treedepth_hits <= thresholds$max_treedepth_exceeded &
      min_bfmi >= thresholds$min_bfmi,
    FALSE
  ))
}

refit_unconverged <- function(fits, seed) {
  imap(fits, \(fit, index) {
    if (passes_thresholds(fit_diagnostics(fit))) {
      return(fit)
    }
    update(fit, iter = 4000L, seed = seed + 500000L + index, refresh = 0L)
  })
}
```

## Adjusted model

```{r}
#| label: fit-adjusted

if (!file.exists(adjusted_model_path)) {
  # brm_multiple() seeds only compilation; seed R's RNG for the Stan seeds.
  set.seed(config$seeds$supporting + 2601L)

  adjusted_fits <- brm_multiple(
    bf(n_imaging_total ~ tx + age + ecog_group + offset(log(exposure_days))),
    data = completed_datasets,
    family = negbinomial(),
    prior = coefficient_prior,
    chains = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    cores = 1L,
    init = 0,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2601L,
    combine = FALSE,
    refresh = 0L
  )

  adjusted_fits <- refit_unconverged(
    adjusted_fits,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2601L
  )

  saveRDS(adjusted_fits, adjusted_model_path, compress = "xz")
}

adjusted_fits <- readRDS(adjusted_model_path)
```

## Unadjusted model

```{r}
#| label: fit-unadjusted

if (!file.exists(unadjusted_model_path)) {
  unadjusted_fits <- list(brm(
    bf(n_imaging_total ~ tx + offset(log(exposure_days))),
    data = imaging_data,
    family = negbinomial(),
    prior = coefficient_prior,
    chains = 4L,
    iter = 2000L,
    cores = 1L,
    init = 0,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2602L,
    refresh = 0L
  ))

  unadjusted_fits <- refit_unconverged(
    unadjusted_fits,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2602L
  )

  saveRDS(unadjusted_fits, unadjusted_model_path, compress = "xz")
}

unadjusted_fits <- readRDS(unadjusted_model_path)
```

## Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: model-diagnostics

model_diagnostics <- bind_rows(
  adjusted = list_rbind(map(adjusted_fits, fit_diagnostics), names_to = "imputation"),
  unadjusted = list_rbind(map(unadjusted_fits, fit_diagnostics), names_to = "imputation"),
  .id = "adjustment"
) |>
  mutate(passed = passes_thresholds(pick(everything())))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-model-diagnostics
#| tbl-cap: "Convergence diagnostics per model and imputation"

kable(model_diagnostics, digits = 3)
```

- Fits passing every threshold: `r sum(model_diagnostics$passed)` of `r nrow(model_diagnostics)`

```{r}
#| label: tbl-adjusted-coefficients
#| tbl-cap: "Posterior coefficients of the adjusted imaging model (first imputation)"

adjusted_fits[[1]] |>
  fixef() |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```
